Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Siya - 9 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Shalini - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Karan - 36 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
5. Ayaan - 12 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Siya stands in the living room. Ishaan, Shalini and Karan stand near her.]

Siya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Siya puts on red lipstick.]

Siya: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan does his homework at the table.]

Karan: "Show me too!"

[Ishaan slams the door shut.]

Shalini: "And then?"

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

[Ishaan stands in the kitchen. Shalini and Karan stand near him.]

Ishaan: "Dad, look over here."

[Ishaan makes tea for everyone.]

Ishaan: "Careful!"

[Ishaan chops onions for the curry.]

Shalini: "Careful!"

[Ishaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Ishaan: "What a day to remember!"
